capabilities: Display month, week, day and agenda calendar views
Parse timed tasks and time blocks from daily notes
Jump from a calendar event to its source note
Update the calendar when files change
Configure first day of week and event insertion points
extras: Installable via BRAT; manifest mentions Tasks, DataView and Kanban task formats as event sources, though the README details only daily-note parsing.
problem: Obsidian daily notes store timed tasks and events as plain text with no way to see them laid out on a calendar.
summary: Full-calendar view plugin that shows month, week, day and agenda views of timed tasks and time blocks parsed from daily notes.
